CustomField.description: Days carried IN from the prior year, set once by the January grant. This is an input to Available = Accrued + Carried In - Used and is NOT decremented as days are taken, so it is not a remaining balance - see Carry Over Remaining for that. On 1 July the sweep reduces it to exactly the number of carried days that were consumed, which cancels those days against Used and drops the unused ones; a non-zero value after that date means days were taken, not days still available.
CustomField.label: Carried In Days
